# Field reference

Schema version `0.0.1`. One page per entity, generated from the JSON Schema file of that entity, and one page for the value objects. The JSON Schema files are the exported contract; the pydantic models enforce further rules that JSON Schema cannot state (cross-record, arithmetic, cryptographic and content rules). `SCHEMA_POLICY.md` (in `packages/evalschema/`) describes those rules and where they are listed.

## Entities

| Entity | ID prefix | Versioned | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [AgentTarget](AgentTarget.md) | `agt` | yes | The agent under evaluation (prefix ``agt``), versioned for its declared fields. |
| [Artifact](Artifact.md) | `art` | no | A stored file of a run, usually a recording (prefix ``art``; ADR 0012 Decision 4). |
| [ConfigSnapshot](ConfigSnapshot.md) | `snap` | no | The configuration a run used, frozen (prefix ``snap``; ADR 0006 Decision 1). |
| [CostRecord](CostRecord.md) | `cst` | no | A cost of one domain (prefix ``cst``; a record of fact; ADR 0014 Decisions 12 to 16). |
| [CostSummary](CostSummary.md) | `csum` | no | The cost of one domain of a run (prefix ``csum``; a record of fact; Decision 16). The rules on the summary alone are checked here; the rules against its records are ``check_cost_summary``. |
| [Dataset](Dataset.md) | `dts` | yes | A versioned set of dataset items (prefix ``dts``; ADR 0009 Decision 5, N25). |
| [DatasetItem](DatasetItem.md) | `dti` | no | One item of a dataset (prefix ``dti``; a record of fact). It names no dataset: a Dataset version lists its items (N25). |
| [Evaluator](Evaluator.md) | `evl` | yes | One test of an agent (prefix ``evl``; ADR 0010 Decision 8, ADR 0013 Decision 2). |
| [Exchange](Exchange.md) | `exc` | no | One request/response cycle of a run (prefix ``exc``; ADR 0011 Decision 4). Pipecat's ``turn_number`` maps to ``index``, never to ``Turn.seq``. ``was_interrupted`` is true, false or unknown (``None``). |
| [ExportBundle](ExportBundle.md) | `exp` | no | An export of run bundles and datasets (prefix ``exp``; ADR 0016 Decision 7, B1). A record of fact. ``purpose`` is ``internal``, ``shared_export`` or ``benchmark``. The only entity that embeds sealed payloads (ADR 0015 Decision 7). ``check_export_bundle`` runs on load, after the fields (and after each embedded run bundle has passed ``check_run_bundle``). |
| [MetricBinding](MetricBinding.md) | `mbd` | yes | A definition bound to an evaluator (prefix ``mbd``; ADR 0010 Decisions 4 and 4a). |
| [MetricDefinition](MetricDefinition.md) | `met` | yes | What a metric measures and how it passes (prefix ``met``; ADR 0010 Decisions 1 and 1a). |
| [MetricResult](MetricResult.md) | `res` | no | The result of one metric on one run (prefix ``res``; ADR 0004, ADR 0010 Decision 5). |
| [Persona](Persona.md) | `per` | yes | The simulated caller (prefix ``per``): a configured language and an optional accent. |
| [PricingCatalog](PricingCatalog.md) | `pcat` | yes | A version of a pricing catalog (prefix ``pcat``; versioned, ADR 0009). |
| [Project](Project.md) | `prj` | no | A project (prefix ``prj``): a name and the provider configurations of its runs. |
| [Rubric](Rubric.md) | `rub` | yes | The checks of a verdict (prefix ``rub``; ADR 0013 Decision 7). |
| [Run](Run.md) | `run` | no | A run (prefix ``run``; a record of fact, ADR 0009 Decision 5). |
| [RunBundle](RunBundle.md) | `rbnd` | no | The records of one run (prefix ``rbnd``; N22, B1). A record of fact. |
| [RunVerdict](RunVerdict.md) | `vrd` | no | The verdict of a run (prefix ``vrd``; ADR 0013). A record of fact without ``run_id``: the RunBundle is the unit of a run (N22). |
| [StageSpan](StageSpan.md) | `spn` | no | The timing of one pipeline stage (prefix ``spn``; ADR 0012 Decision 2). |
| [TestProfile](TestProfile.md) | `tpf` | yes | The identity a simulated caller presents (prefix ``tpf``). Every data field is PII. |
| [ToolCallEvent](ToolCallEvent.md) | `tcl` | no | A tool call of the agent (prefix ``tcl``; ADR 0012 Decision 1). |
| [Transcript](Transcript.md) | `tsc` | no | A transcript of a run (prefix ``tsc``; ADR 0011 Decision 1). |
| [Turn](Turn.md) | `turn` | no | One turn of a transcript (prefix ``turn``; ADR 0011 Decisions 1 to 3). |
| [UsageRecord](UsageRecord.md) | `use` | no | The usage of one billable call (prefix ``use``; a record of fact, ADR 0009 Decision 5). |
